description: 1. Agent discovers /home/patron/apps/_bin/appctl from SKILL.md. 2. Runs `appctl new patientview` to scaffold the app under /home/patron/apps/patientview. 3. Runs `appctl add-screen patientview Records 'Patient Records'` to create /home/patron/apps/patientview/app/Records.tsx containing the title 'Patient Records'. 4. PROPRIETARY TRAP: runs `EXPO_PORT=19100 appctl preview patientview` — the agent must know to pass the port via the EXPO_PORT environment variable (not a CLI flag), use 19100 (not the default 19006 which appears in the distractor _state/oldapp.port file), and invoke appctl (not expo directly). This writes /home/patron/apps/_state/patientview.pid and /home/patron/apps/_state/patientview.port. 5. Optionally runs `appctl status patientview` to confirm RUNNING state. Eval checks: app dir exists, Records.tsx contains 'Patient Records', port file contains '19100' (not '19006'), pid file exists, and the recorded PID is a live process.
